summary: Re-point the four remaining T063/T066 consumers that A0014 recorded and close both open findings on each of the two targets that carries one. T073 depends on T105 and T107 and shows only current registry-bound evidence and candidate identity, fails closed on an absent, mismatched or downgraded artifact, and keeps legacy artifacts historical and visibly non-current while the pool, token and paper authorization order is unchanged. T083 depends on T107 and its dossier resolves the released candidate only to a registry-bound lock, keeps old locks immutable, byte-identical and unpromotable, and blocks rather than falls back on a mismatch or unavailable revision. T084 depends on T105, displays the registered strategy identity and the schema/registry revision the manifest records without inventing, substituting or rewriting them, and reconciles its P08 console-scope paragraph and acceptance with ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 as it now stands, claiming no surface that section assigns to T087 or T088. T101 depends on T105 and T069 and assembles its panel and labels only from the declared run's validated manifests, preserving source checksums, dataset, run, member and registry identity and refusing incompatible revisions, failed or cancelled runs and legacy input. Resolved: A0014:T073:use-current-evidence-and-candidate, A0014:T083:consume-registry-bound-candidate-lock, A0014:T084:present-current-manifest-provenance, A0013:T084:legacy, A0014:T101:assemble-panel-from-current-run-manifests, A0013:T101:legacy.
rationale: Owner direction executed inside the CONTRACT layer, inside the four named targets only, each edited contract carrying its four dependency fields and nothing else outside it. T073 (todo/phases/P07-risk-and-paper/T073.md): T063 and T066 are replaced by their successors T105 and T107 in Dependencies and in every normative reference; the authorization views now read the current T105 manifest and reports and the current T107 candidate lock with the registered strategy identity, strategy version, registry revision and parameter-schema identity it freezes; a T063 manifest or T066 lock may appear only as an explicitly historical, non-current artifact and is never copied into a new authorization; an absent, mismatched or downgraded current manifest or candidate lock fails closed; acceptance adds positive current-evidence display and negative legacy, mismatch and downgrade cases; Must not forbids treating a legacy artifact or an absent, mismatched or downgraded current artifact as authorization evidence; and the three journeys, their write path, the pool/token/paper authorization order, the P07 entry-gate clause and the bounded-scope clause are unchanged (closes A0014:T073:use-current-evidence-and-candidate). T083 (todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T083.md): T066 is replaced by T107 in Dependencies; readme-style Deliverables text is added stating that the dossier's experiment and candidate evidence comes only from the current registry-bound T107 lock and names the released candidate version, registered strategy identity, registry/schema revision, content hash and actor; a T066 lock stays immutable, byte-identical, never rewritten or backfilled and never promoted; acceptance adds the current-lock resolution case and the old-format, content-hash or revision mismatch and unavailable-revision refusals; Must not forbids promoting a legacy, absent, mismatched or downgraded lock; and the frozen deliverable list, clean-room reproduction, checkbox-to-evidence and issue-severity clauses are preserved (closes A0014:T083:consume-registry-bound-candidate-lock). T084 (todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T084.md): T063 is replaced by T105 in Dependencies and in the manifest-provenance sentence; the 'Console scope in P08' paragraph no longer reads as if T084-T086 were the whole P08 web surface - it records that ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 assigns robinhood_lp.web to T084-T086 and, since A0014, records two further P08 web-module rows owned by T087 (WEB-PAGE-012) and T088 (WEB-PAGE-013), which the paragraph and the acceptance place explicitly outside this task's acceptance without claiming ownership of them; deliverables and acceptance require the displayed provenance to include the registered strategy identity and the schema/registry revision the manifest records, a current-and-legacy render that distinguishes them, a mismatch that fails closed, and no free-text or inferred substitution; Must not adds the matching substitution and legacy-presentation prohibitions; T063 thus disappears as a normative input while remaining named only as the legacy artifact (closes A0014:T084:present-current-manifest-provenance and A0013:T084:legacy). T101 (todo/phases/P10-research-and-models/T101.md): T063 is replaced by T105 and T069 is added, so the panel is assembled only from the validated manifest set of the T069 run the configuration names, with a new deliverable bullet binding every sample to its run identity, dataset version, member identity, registry revision and source checksums and refusing manifests outside the declared run, members with a disagreeing registry or schema revision, failed or cancelled runs and legacy pre-registry manifests; acceptance adds panel provenance plus deduplication and the incompatible-revision, failed/cancelled-run and legacy-rejection cases, the boundary list gains the same cases, Must not forbids merging or backfilling incompatible or unsuccessful or legacy input and inferring an unrecorded identity, and the T068 registry identity is reached transitively through T069 and T105 (both declare T068, measured) so no redundant direct edge is added (closes A0014:T101:assemble-panel-from-current-run-manifests and A0013:T101:legacy). Every other recorded impact stays open and untouched, and this amendment names them: A0013:T063:legacy, A0013:T064:legacy, A0013:T066:legacy, A0013:T067:legacy (the four retirement-route findings, which no consumer re-pointing can close), A0013:T071:legacy, A0013:T072:legacy, A0013:T082:legacy, A0013:T085:legacy, A0013:T086:legacy, A0013:T091:legacy, A0013:T096:legacy, A0013:T102:legacy, A0013:T103:legacy, A0013:T104:legacy, A0014:T087:read-current-manifest-coverage, A0014:T088:reconcile-current-result-checksums, A0014:T096:include-successor-final-evidence and A0014:T102:consume-schema-bound-robustness (18 open impacts before this amendment, 24 minus the six it closes; recomputed from todo/amendments/*/impacts.json). No new conflict is created: after this change no ordinary PLANNED consumer remains on T063 (its consumers are the successor T105 and the APPROVED T064, which T106 replaces) or on T066 (its only consumer is the successor T107), which is what T105 and T107 require of later CONTRACT amendments, but retiring either predecessor stays a separate SUPERSEDE act and this amendment sets no superseded_by, status, attempt, evidence, commit, revision or review field. The four remaining T063/T066 occurrences in the edited text are legacy-only prohibitions and renderings, not normative consumption: three in T073, three in T083 and four in T084, all naming the predecessor artifact as historical, non-current or refused.

impact_assessment.intent: No Intent change and no intent_revision change: this amendment cites obligations that already exist and adds none. The registry-bound identity rule it enforces is G-STRATEGY-REGISTRY-01 (docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md:506: every executable strategy has a registered identity, a manifest's strategy identity must come from the registry and an unregistered identity is rejected); the pre-paper authorization boundary T073 carries is G-PAPER-AUTHORIZE-01 (:536); the product-run lifecycle T101's panel must anchor to is G-BACKTEST-RUN-01 (:508). docs/intent/PROJECT_GOALS.md was not edited, and no new goal, threshold or acceptance condition is introduced.
impact_assessment.specification: No Spec change and no spec_revision change. The edited text rests on clauses that already exist and were read in the tree: ARCHITECTURE.md section 2.2 assigns robinhood_lp.web to T084-T086 (docs/spec/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md:131) and records T087 robinhood_lp.web.runs (:155) and T088 robinhood_lp.web.backtest_result (:156), the T105/T107 successor rows (:133/:135), the T073 row (:137) and the T101 row (:142); WEB_CONSOLE.md WEB-PAGE-012 (:179, owned by T087 at :186-188) and WEB-PAGE-013 (:191, owned by T088 at :202) sit outside the T084-T086 acceptance scope; WEB-GLOBAL-006 governs T073's bounded entry point; DS-031 and DS-002/DS-043 govern the candidate lock and artifact versioning T083 and T101 report. Nothing in this amendment contradicts, duplicates or rewrites a specification clause, and the two module-path tokens the first T084 draft would have added were removed rather than suppressed because the suppression registry is outside this layer.
impact_assessment.contracts: Exactly four contracts changed, the four named targets: todo/phases/P07-risk-and-paper/T073.md, todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T083.md, todo/phases/P08-operations-and-web/T084.md and todo/phases/P10-research-and-models/T101.md, plus the four corresponding depends_on lists in todo/config.yaml. Each keeps its Dependencies, Outcome, Deliverables, Acceptance, Must not and References sections exactly once, and each Dependencies line equals its configured list. affected_existing_tasks is empty because no other existing contract is left asserting something these four now deny: T105 already required T069, T073, T084 and T101 to consume it and T107 already required T066 to be replaced by it in T073 and T083, so both successor contracts describe this change rather than contradict it; T087 and T088 keep their own still-open T063 findings, which this amendment deliberately leaves open; T064 keeps only its dependency line on T063 and is itself on the retirement route through T106; and T086, T090 and T093 name T083 only in their Dependencies, which are unchanged.
impact_assessment.dependencies: T073 depends_on becomes [T025, T027, T105, T107]; T083 becomes [T082, T107]; T084 becomes [T025, T072, T080, T105]; T101 becomes [T050, T069, T100, T104, T105]. Each list is sorted, duplicate-free and equal to its contract's Dependencies line (checked with the repository's own rule). T101 gains a direct T069 edge because no path to the run lifecycle existed before (the run entry point depends on T105, not the reverse), while T068 registry identity is reached transitively through both T069 and T105, so no redundant direct edge was added. Measured effects: a full-graph depth-first check finds no cycle; each target's closure contains the successors it now names (T073: 43 tasks including T105/T107; T083: 47 including T107; T084: 42 including T105; T101: 42 including T069/T068/T105); T063 now has exactly two consumers, the successor T105 and the APPROVED T064, and T066 exactly one, its successor T107, so neither predecessor has a remaining ordinary PLANNED consumer and neither is retired here.
impact_assessment.implementation: No source, test, schema, tool, CI or non-target configuration file is edited; the change set is exactly the four contracts and the four depends_on lists in todo/config.yaml. All four targets are PLANNED at attempt 0, so this amendment replaces no shipped behaviour and no candidate is activated. The implemented behaviour these successors retire (the hard-coded five-name VALID_STRATEGY_KINDS validator and the rerun-manifest CLI integration for the manifest, and the T066 candidate lock for the candidate identity) keeps its disposition where T105 and T107 already place it: adapt or replace on cutover, old parsers readable only as explicitly versioned legacy readers, and no current publication or evaluation path may use the legacy format. The edited contracts avoid creating a second authoritative path: T073 displays registry-bound artifacts without writing them, T083 reports the lock rather than producing a second one, T084 stays a read model, and T101 consumes the run's manifests without acquiring run or lock ownership.
impact_assessment.data: No persisted data, artifact, checksum or lock is read, rewritten or migrated by this amendment, and none is created. The obligations it adds are preservation obligations on future work: historical T063 manifests, reports and checksums and T066 candidate locks stay byte-identical and read-only, are never backfilled with a registry identity, are marked legacy wherever a current surface would otherwise show them, and cannot be promoted into current promotion, authorization, release or panel evidence. No registry revision is inferred, and no artifact is relabelled from legacy to current. Registry records remain deterministic and non-secret.
impact_assessment.operations: No running process, deployment, runtime configuration, CLI surface or background job changes, and no runtime model or workflow state moves. Operationally the amendment preserves every existing clause: T073 keeps its three-journey order, its versioned write path, its reauthentication and its position as the P07 entry gate before T071 or T072 operate paper; T083 keeps its clean-room reproduction and issue-severity release gate; T084 keeps the read-only shell, the explicit unknown/absent state where no dataset stands behind a surface and the non-blocking stance towards T087, T088, T100 and T103; T101 keeps its per-pool research window and its harness boundary. Ordering for later work follows the recorded cutover: the registry T068 and manifest authority T105 are already wired, and only the remaining successor evidence, retirement and evidence-gate work stays open.
impact_assessment.security: No new permission, trust boundary, credential or secret surface is added. T073 remains the single Owner write boundary for pool selection, HOLD/LP approval and preliminary-paper authorization, and the new evidence and candidate views grant no authority: registry binding is not authorization and a legacy or mismatched artifact authorizes nothing. T083's lock evidence grants no live permission and cannot satisfy T094. T084 stays a read model that redacts secrets and cannot mutate domain state. T101's run, member and registry identity binding grants no execution authority. No secret, endpoint value or key material was read, printed or written anywhere in this amendment.

The checks had to be run with the project interpreter /home/lpdev/miniconda3/envs/robinhood-lp/bin/python (3.12.14), because the default /usr/bin/python3 is 3.10 and cannot import tomllib; the citation checker caught a first T084 draft that named two unresolvable p08 web module paths, and that text was reworded instead of suppressed because docs/implement/ci/suppressions.toml is outside every amendment layer. The amended contracts' own verification obligations are extended, not relaxed: T073 adds positive current-evidence display plus legacy, mismatch and downgrade cases; T083 adds the current lock resolution plus old-format, mismatch and unavailable-revision cases; T084 adds current-and-legacy provenance rendering, mismatch and no-free-text-substitution cases; T101 adds panel provenance, deduplication, incompatible-revision, failed or cancelled run and legacy rejection cases. No test was run as proof of completion, and no evidence, approval or review record was created or altered.
